out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Described peaceful/pleasant floating out of body after sensing bodily life/light extinguish; later reported OBE-like all-direction awareness.

tunnel.movement_other_detail: In the March 2008 tunnel he was 'mostly stationary' looking down the tunnel; in the 1993 tunnel he and his brother were 'moving up the tunnel'.

arrival.religious_figure_detail: Interpreted the female being of light as possibly Kuan Yin / Bodhisattva of Compassion (later association with Dalai Lama article; also noted resemblance to Mother Mary).
arrival.other_being_detail: A 'young boy' companion/helper with the female being; both 'made of light' and 'radiant'.

environment.environment_other_detail: Tunnel light described as 'beautiful white tunnel' with 'varied and multi-hued' textured light; end brighter; a 'boundary toward the end'.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Severe prolonged illness attributed to multiple parasites after travel in Asia; extreme weakness and inability to eat/digest well. Also a childhood event near brother's sudden death after a fall.

person_demographics.religious_background_detail: Raised in a mostly Christian environment in the USA; went to Catholic church; described family as spiritual/open to multiple traditions.
person_demographics.religious_belief_at_nde_detail: At ~21: meditation practitioner involved with Buddhism; not a single specific religion. At ~6: around Christian things; beliefs unclear.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Two separate episodes in March 2008 (tunnel vision; then OBE after sensing bodily 'life/light' extinguish). Separate childhood tunnel episode in May 1993 with telepathic message from brother.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: March 2008: tunnel vision while on bed with beings at end, then back to body; later (next day) a separate episode of bodily shutdown sensation followed by brief OBE and return. May 1993: tunnel with brother, telepathic message to return, then sudden return to body.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Tunnel/light themes recur across 2008 and 1993 experiences; beings of light later reappear in waking/dream/inner vision (post-NDE).

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Reported premonitory sense weeks prior that he would die soon and that 'the veil between worlds was thin.' Described a somatic process of each cell's 'life/light' extinguishing like candles before an OBE. Later recurring visions/appearances of the two beings with advice/healing energy; meditation reproducing many NDE-like elements.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I immediately found myself looking down a beautiful white tunnel.” “The light was not uniform… varied and multi-hued, like it had texture.” “All the life and light in each of the cells of my body [was] slowly extinguishing… like a little candle in each cell… going out.” “It’s not your time. You have to go back.” “Well, I guess I’m still alive.”
